title: Review: jmap-client crate — base client RFC 8620
notes:
Maintainer risk: MEDIUM — two API footguns (non_exhaustive missing, download_blob positional params) and one inconsistent configuration surface (SSE limit hardcoded). No security or correctness bugs found.
Confidence: 5% chance of missed bug. Least confident flags: none — the P0 section is clean. Uncertainty driven by: not running the code, not seeing the extension crates that call pub(crate) fields. Would raise confidence if: integration test against a real JMAP server, or reviewing jmap-mail-client/jmap-chat-client to confirm pub(crate) field usage pattern.
Idiom rating: ACCEPTABLE — no unsafe, no unwrap in non-test code, ownership model is sound. Two real idiom issues: missing non_exhaustive on ClientError (breaking-change risk), and gratuitous args.clone() in extract_response (avoidable with &Value Deserializer). Both are fixable without API breakage.
Rust idiom confidence: 10% chance of missed issue. Least confident flags: JMAP-636.10 (args.clone) — need to verify &Value Deserializer impl is in the serde_json version pinned in Cargo.toml. Uncertainty driven by: not verifying serde_json &Value Deserializer at the pinned version.
